text:
Maria Chen: Hey team :wave: kicking off Azure Private Offer onboarding for the new private/offers flow. Need to confirm KMS key ownership, trial SKU behavior, and legal flags for the EULA. Can ops/eng/legal weigh in?

Kevin Patel: Thanks. Quick checklist from infra side: 1) Customer-managed KMS key ARN or key URI? 2) Do we need separate tenant service principal per publisher? 3) Is Private Offer expected to use reserved IP ranges (VNet integration)?

Devon Li: For our Private deployment we require a Key Vault key URI (not an ARN). We'll need contributor access to the key during packaging step to encrypt listing artifacts. We can do a short-lived principal if legal prefers.

Anne Rodriguez: Legal: EULA templates for private offers differ. We need the negotiated terms attached as an artifact and a flag in the listing metadata to prevent auto-accept. Also confirm whether trial terms require an opt-in checkbox on the offer page.

Samir Khan: Product question: how should we name the trial SKU? current suggestion: `redwood-private-1vCPU-trial` — but that looks too infra-y. Proposing `Redwood Private — Trial (Small)` as displayName with internal SKU `RP-TRIAL-S`. Thoughts?

Jen Park: Solutions/partner-facing: display name should be customer-friendly. Also want telemetry hook: subaccount_id mapping so trial activations flow into our billing/test analytics. Can we include a `metadata.trial_flow` boolean?

Kevin Patel: Regarding metadata: Azure store accepts custom `planProperties` key-value pairs in the offer manifest. We can add `trial_flow=true` there. For KMS: we need an MSI or service principal with `get` permission on Key Vault keys. Sample ARM snippet we used: 
```json
"identity": { "type": "UserAssigned", "userAssignedIdentities": { "/subscriptions/<sub>/resourceGroups/<rg>/providers/Microsoft.ManagedIdentity/userAssignedIdentities/<name>": {} } }
```
(then grant `Key Vault Crypto User` role to that identity)

Anne Rodriguez: On the opt-in checkbox: Legal requires explicit acceptance for trial terms in private offers. Add `eula.opt_in_required = true` to manifest and include the exact EULA attachment in assets. Also we need contact info for dispute/resolution in the metadata.

Maria Chen: Noted. Action items so far: - Devon: confirm Key Vault URI format + sample policy - Kevin: add `trial_flow` to planProperties and share manifest snippet - Anne: provide EULA template and required contact language - Samir/Jen: finalize display name and telemetry keys

Devon Li: I can provide Key Vault URI example: `https://redwood-kv.vault.azure.net/keys/private-offer-key/abcd1234`. Also: we recommend using key rotation window 90 days for private artifacts.

Samir Khan: Display name proposal updated: `Redwood Private — Trial (Starter)`; internal SKU `rp_trial_starter_v1`. Jen, will that map ok to telemetry?

Jen Park: Yes, map `rp_trial_starter_v1` -> telemetry `trial_sku: rp_trial_starter_v1`. Also add `metadata.utm_source=azure_marketplace` so we can segment.

Kevin Patel: Upload manifest prototype to the partnership bucket at `s3://redwood-partnerships/azure/private-offers/1757654321/manifest.json` once ready. CI will validate `planProperties` keys.

Anne Rodriguez: Legal will attach `EULA_Redwood_Private_2026-03-01.pdf` to the same folder. Reminder: include clause about telemetry collection and data residency.

redwood-bot: Checklist created: [KMS_uri][Manifest][EULA_attachment][Telemetry_mapping][Trial_flag] — assigned to Maria, Devon, Kevin, Anne, Jen.

Maria Chen: Timeline? Can we target packaging + manifest by EOD Thursday so we can kick legal review Friday?

Devon Li: EOD Thursday works for Key Vault sample + principal instructions.

Kevin Patel: I'll draft manifest snippets tomorrow morning and ping here.

Anne Rodriguez: Legal review likely Friday afternoon if artifacts are in the folder.

Samir Khan: I'll lock the display name and SKU today.

Jen Park: I'll update the telemetry mapping doc and add integration test checklist for trial activation events.

Maria Chen: Great. If anyone hits blockers drop them here. Also tagging @DevOps for any Azure Publisher quota quirks — @DevOps can you confirm publisher limits?

Devon Li: pinging DevOps separately.

Kevin Patel: One more note: for private offers we sometimes need a `contactEmail` visible on the offer. Confirm with sales whether to use partnerships@redwood.ai or a customer-specific contact.

Anne Rodriguez: Default to partnerships@redwood.ai unless contract states otherwise.

Maria Chen: Perfect. Thanks all :thumbsup:
